_meta.purpose: Canonical machine-readable schema for Compliance Pack bundles. Each pack ships a versioned, signed bundle of Cedar fragments + audit-chain requirements + data-class extensions + cell-eligibility constraints + retention rules + consent requirements + cross-tenant rules + jurisdiction overlays + DPIA template references + breach-notification workflow references + explicit regulator citations. The v1.1.0 contract slice also specifies optional signature-contract metadata, cell certification state, SOC2-style evidence collectors, five-purpose CMP consent, and portability-export fixture references without claiming runtime implementation, certification, tenant activation, or production readiness. Consumed by the policy-engine pack loader, the tenancy substrate's pack-activation gate, and the check-compliance-pack-coverage CI lane.
_meta.claim_boundary: Schema/fixture contract only. ADR-0250, ADR-0251, ADR-0272, and ADR-0276 remain proposed planning inputs unless separately elevated; this file alone does not implement a pack registry, runtime collector, CMP, portability service, certification, tenant activation, auditor acceptance, or production readiness.

pack_id.description: Canonical pack identifier following `<FRAMEWORK>-<YEAR-OR-VERSION>[-<JURISDICTION-OR-VARIANT>]` convention. Letters + numerals + hyphens + dots. Each pack_id is unique across the platform.

version.description: Semantic version per semver 2.0. Major bumps when control surface changes; minor when overlays extend; patch for editorial-only updates.

standard_version.description: Precise external framework/standard revision when the stable pack_id intentionally omits patch-level source revisions. For PCI, pack_id can remain PCI-DSS-L1-v4 while standard_version records 4.0.1.

source_revision.description: Source acquisition and reconciliation metadata for the external standard or template rows backing this pack. This is citation/version evidence only, not certification/readiness evidence.

source_refs.description: Source ids in the regulatory/source-of-truth registry or equivalent evidence index.

retrieval_status.description: Current acquisition state, for example fetched-ok, blocked-http-403, manual-acquisition-required, or pending-template-row.

sha256.description: Hash of acquired source content when available; null when the source row is blocked or manual acquisition is pending.

claim_ceiling.description: Explicit boundary preventing source-version metadata from being treated as readiness, certification, assessor, scan, or tenant-activation evidence.

signed_by.description: Compliance-office signing key identifier. Format: `compliance-office:<pack-id>:<key-version>` for first-party packs; `external-attestor:<name>:<key-version>` for third-party-attested packs (e.g., big-4 audit firm signing a SOC 2 pack mapping).

signature.description: Ed25519 signature over the canonical CBOR-encoded pack bundle (excluding the `signature` field itself). Lowercase hex; 128 chars = 64 bytes.

signature_contract.description: Optional v1.1.0 signature verification contract. This records how a pack signature is computed and verified without claiming that any concrete pack is certified or auditor-accepted.

public_key_ref.description: Key registry or transparency-log reference for the signing public key.

claim_boundary.description: Explicit non-claim boundary for signature metadata.

cedar_fragments.description: References to Cedar fragments shipped by this pack. Each fragment is identified by its fragment_id + version + cosign_attestation_ref. The policy-engine loads these fragments under scope `pack/<pack-id>` when a tenant activates the pack.

fragment_id.description: Cedar fragment_id per /specs/cedar-fragment-schema.json. Must start with `pack-` and match this pack's id stem.

audit_chain_requirements.description: Audit-chain requirements imposed by this pack. Tenants activating this pack inherit these as minimums (more-restrictive baseline takes precedence; pack-imposed requirements cannot be relaxed by tenant overrides).

retention_min.description: Minimum audit-log retention duration in ISO 8601 duration format. Pack may not relax below regulator minimum.

breach_notification_workflow_id.description: Workflow Engine workflow ID that orchestrates breach notification per regulator timing requirements (e.g., GDPR 72-hour).

tamper_detection_frequency.description: ISO 8601 duration between Merkle-seal verification cycles. Pack-specified minimum.

at_rest.description: Data at rest must be encrypted (AES-256 or stronger).

in_transit.description: Data in transit must be encrypted (TLS 1.3 or stronger).

in_use.description: Data in use must be encrypted (confidential computing / TEE).

evidence_collectors.description: Optional v1.1.0 continuous-evidence collector declarations. SOC2-style collectors mirror ADR-0209's CI hash, deploy receipt, access review, backup drill, vulnerability scan, and pen-test evidence rows while remaining contract-only until the collector runtime exists.

source_system.description: Source of evidence, for example cloud-ci, deploy-ledger, Cedar/Zitadel access review, DR drill runner, vulnerability scanner, or external assessor upload.

cadence.description: Collection cadence: per-build, per-deploy, weekly, quarterly, per-image, annual, or an ISO 8601 duration.

artifact_kind.description: Canonical evidence artifact kind produced by the collector.

seal_required.description: Whether an audit-chain seal or equivalent tamper-evidence reference is mandatory before the artifact is publishable.

claim_boundary.description: Explicit non-claim boundary for this collector declaration.

data_class_extensions.description: New data class identifiers introduced or refined by this pack per ADR-0099 data-class registry. Pack-defined classes are namespaced by pack_id to avoid collisions.

provider_byok_required.description: Per ADR-0255 §D-4. LLM/provider BYOK requirement. When true, every tenant activating this pack is forced to `provider_credential_mode = byok_required_by_pack`; `platform_default` provider credentials are refused at admission. Typical of HIPAA (BAA-only providers required), PCI DSS, FedRAMP, IL5/6, KR-FSS, and EU AI Act high-risk packs. Disjoint from `encryption_byok_required` below, which is at-rest KMS / HSM root scope.

encryption_byok_required.description: Per ADR-0251 §D-10. Encryption-key BYOK requirement. When true, every tenant activating this pack must supply its own KMS root key or HSM partition for at-rest data encryption; the tenant row's `byok_enabled` flag is forced to TRUE at admission. Typical of HIPAA, PCI DSS Level 1, FedRAMP High, IL5/6, KR-FSS, KR-CSAP. Disjoint from `provider_byok_required` above, which is LLM/provider API credential scope.

cell_eligibility.description: Cell-level constraints per ADR-0251 + ADR-0248. Tenants activating this pack may only operate in cells meeting these requirements.

requires_certification.description: List of certification levels a cell must hold to host pack-activated tenants. References Compliance Pack & Cell Certification Levels per ADR-0251.

forbidden_cells.description: Explicit cell IDs or patterns where pack-activated tenants cannot be placed. Supports glob patterns like `data-plane-cn-*` to exclude entire regions.

cell_certification_state.description: Optional v1.1.0 state contract for the cell certification lifecycle consumed by pack placement gates. This is a state/evidence descriptor only and does not assert that any live cell is certified.

state.description: Current declarative state for a cell/pack tuple. Only `certified` can satisfy launch gates, and only with external evidence references supplied by the placement substrate.

certification_level_ref.description: Reference to the cell certification level required by this pack, for example SOC2-T2-evidence-collecting or EU-GDPR-eligible.

claim_boundary.description: Explicit non-claim boundary for certification state metadata.

retention_rules.description: Per-data-class retention overrides imposed by this pack. Pack rules supersede baseline; pack rules cannot relax below regulator minimum.

data_class.description: Data class identifier (per data-class registry) this rule applies to.

min_duration_iso8601.description: Minimum retention duration per ISO 8601 duration.

max_duration_iso8601.description: Maximum retention duration (data must be erased after this). NULL means no maximum.

regulator_filing_required.description: Whether retained data must be filed/disclosed to the regulator on request.

rationale.description: Regulator citation or rationale for the rule.

consent_requirements.description: Consent requirements imposed by this pack. Drives consent collection UX, consent storage, and Cedar context attributes during evaluation.

explicit.description: Whether opt-in must be explicit (vs implied/opt-out). True for GDPR; required for HIPAA authorizations; required for KR-PIPA.

granular.description: Whether consent must be per-purpose granular (vs blanket). True for GDPR + KR-PIPA.

revocable.description: Whether consent must be revocable at any time without penalty. True for GDPR + KR-PIPA.

purpose_consent_types.description: Enumerated per-purpose consent types this pack requires the platform to support.

minimum_age_years.description: Minimum age for valid consent without parental authorization. NULL means not applicable. GDPR Article 8: 13-16; KR PIPA: 14; COPPA: 13.

cmp_consent.description: Optional v1.1.0 CMP contract overlay from ADR-0272. It pins the five canonical purposes and the evidence required for consent records without implementing a CMP runtime.

canonical_purposes.description: ADR-0272 five-purpose order. `necessary` is informational/always-on; every other purpose defaults off.

audit_event_class.description: Audit event class emitted for consent grant/revoke/update records.

claim_boundary.description: Explicit non-claim boundary for CMP metadata.

cross_tenant_rules.description: Cross-tenant collaboration constraints imposed by this pack. Drives Cedar gating of cross-tenant actions (share workflow, partner-tenant assume-role, sub-merchant facilitation).

requires_BAA.description: Cross-tenant data sharing requires a Business Associate Agreement (HIPAA).

requires_DPA.description: Cross-tenant data sharing requires a Data Processing Agreement (GDPR Article 28).

requires_NDA.description: Cross-tenant data sharing requires a Non-Disclosure Agreement (commercial confidentiality).

per_action_class_restrictions.description: Per-action-class refinements (e.g., even with a DPA, certain action classes remain prohibited).

ml-training-cross-tenant.rationale: GDPR Article 22 + Article 28: no model training on shared PII without explicit DPIA

jurisdiction_overlay.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (or ISO 3166-2 for sub-national) codes this pack applies to, plus accepted bloc shorthands (EU, EEA). Pack is active for tenants whose `jurisdiction.primary` falls within this list (plus the wildcard `*` for global packs).

dpia_template_id.description: Identifier of the Data Protection Impact Assessment template required for tenants adopting this pack. References `docs/templates/dpia-template.md` plus the per-pack variant.

breach_notification_workflow_id.description: Workflow Engine workflow that the breach saga invokes for this pack. Encodes per-regulator timing (e.g., GDPR Article 33: 72 hours), per-regulator format, per-regulator authority email.

portability_export.description: Optional v1.1.0 portability-export fixture contract from ADR-0276 and GDPR Article 20. This records export format/evidence expectations only; it does not implement export/import services or assert data-subject request readiness.

manifest_schema_ref.description: Schema URI or repository path for the portability export manifest.

fixture_ref.description: Repository path to a non-production fixture proving the portability shape.

claim_boundary.description: Explicit non-claim boundary for portability-export metadata.

regulator_references.description: Explicit citations to laws, regulations, frameworks, and standards this pack maps. Each citation is a free-form human-readable string referencing the regulatory source.

sunset_at.description: Optional pack sunset timestamp. Used when a pack is superseded by a newer version (e.g., HIPAA-2024 superseded by HIPAA-2026 once the latter is published).

created_by.description: Principal that authored this pack version (typically a compliance team principal).

supersedes.description: Previous pack versions this version supersedes. Tenants on superseded packs receive migration notification per ADR-0251.
